blocks.text: Ek be-wazan (massless) chhari ke sire par laga mass m lein (Fig. 3.15). Pivot O par bearing mein friction nahi, aur system horizontal satah mein hai. Mass par chhari ke perpendicular force F lagti hai, jo mass ko yun accelerate karti hai:
Is force se mass O ke gird ghoomne lagta hai. Tangential acceleration a_T aur angular acceleration α ka taalluq:

blocks.alt: Patla daira, markaz par pivot O aur O se dashed ufuqi lakeer. Grey chhari O se daire par mass m ki gend tak, dashed lakeer se zawiya θ oopar. Chhari ke saath naap ki lakeer us ki lambai r dikhati hai, aur gend par teer F chhari se seedha zawiya (right angle) banata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.15: Force F axis O ke gird torque paida karti hai aur mass m ko pivot ke gird angular acceleration alpha deti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ghumane wala asar (turning effect) torque τ paida karta hai, is liye gardish ki equation torque mein likhna behtar hai. Dono taraf r se zarb dein:
Yeh Newton ke doosre qanoon F = ma ki gardishi (rotational) shakal hai.

Yahan F ki jagah τ, a ki jagah α aur m ki jagah mr² aa gaya. mr² ko moment of inertia kehte hain aur I se likhte hain. Gardishi harkat mein moment of inertia wahi kaam karta hai jo seedhi (linear) harkat mein mass: yeh gardish ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat (inertia) ka naap hai. Moment of inertia sirf mass m par nahi balke faasle r² par bhi munhasir hai.

Zyada tar rigid bodies mein mass axis se mukhtalif faaslon par mukhtalif miqdar mein hota hai, yani mass ki taqseem yaksan (uniform) nahi. Fig. 3.16(a) mein jism chhote chhote tukron m₁, m₂, .... se bana hai jo axis O se faaslon r₁, r₂, .... par hain. Agar jism angular acceleration α se ghoome to m₁ par torque:
aur isi tarah baqi tukron par.

blocks.alt: Ek hi be-qaida sakht jism ke do manzar, neela rang, chhoti chokor masses m₁, m₂, m₃ aur m₄ dashed lakeeron r₁, r₂, r₃ aur r₄ se axis O se juri hain. (a) mein m₂, O se guzarti dashed ufuqi lakeer par hai. (b) mein poora jism O ke gird ghoom chuka hai, aur kinare se bahar dashed lakeer ufuqi se zawiya θ banati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16: Bare sakht jism ka har chhota tukra pivot ke gird ek jaisi angular acceleration rakhta hai (kitab ki Figure 3.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jism ghooma to har tukra m₁ se m₄ apne apne faasle r₁ se r₄ par usi angle θ se ghooma; (a) se (b) tak sab ki angular displacement, angular velocity aur angular acceleration barabar hai. Farq sirf faaslon ka hai, is liye kul torque = (m₁r₁² + m₂r₂² + ...)α = Iα.

blocks.alt: Barabar mass ke do lakri ke cylinders, har ek par mura teer apne lambe axis ke gird gardish dikhata hai: oopar chhota magar mota (bare diameter wala) cylinder; neeche lamba patla (chhote diameter wala) cylinder.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 66): barabar mass ke do cylinders; bare diameter wale ka rotational inertia zyada hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dono ka mass barabar hai, magar mote cylinder ka mass axis se zyada door hai. Moment of inertia mass × faasle ka square (r²) par munhasir hai, is liye mote cylinder ko ghumana ya rokna zyada mushkil hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar ajsam, har ek ke markaz se amoodi axis AA'. (a) Lambai L ki patli chhari, axis beech se amood: I = (1/12) mL². (b) Radius r ka patla chhalla (hoop): I = mr². (c) Radius r ki thos disc ya cylinder: I = (1/2) mr². (d) Diameter 2r ka sphere: I = (2/5) mr².
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 66): axis AA' ke gird mukhtalif ajsam ke moments of inertia (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Chaaron ka mass m barabar ho to bhi moment of inertia alag hai, kyunke mass axis se mukhtalif faaslon par phaila hai. Hoop (chhalla) ka saara mass kinare (faasla r) par hai, is liye I = mr² sab se zyada. Disc mein mass beech mein bhi hai, to I = ½mr²; sphere mein aur zyada mass axis ke qareeb hai, to I = ⅖mr². Patli rod (lambai L, beech se axis): I = (1/12)mL².
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.prompt: 60 cm diameter ke 200 kg sphere ka moment of inertia kya hai? Linear harkat mein mass inertia ka naap hai; gardish mein is ki jagah kya hai, aur yeh sirf mass par kyun munhasir nahi?
blocks.explanation: Radius r = 30 cm = 0.30 m. I = ⅖mr² = ⅖ × 200 kg × (0.30 m)² = 7.2 kg m². (Agar diameter 0.60 m ko ghalti se radius le lein to 28.8 kg m² aata hai.) Gardish mein mass ki jagah moment of inertia I = Σmᵢrᵢ² hai, jo angular acceleration ki mukhalifat napta hai (τ = Iα). Yeh mass ke saath saath is baat par bhi munhasir hai ke mass axis se kitna door phaila hai, kyunke har tukra mᵢrᵢ² deta hai.

items: Chhari par mass: F = mrα; dono taraf r se zarb: τ = mr²α, jo F = ma ki gardishi shakal hai (m ki jagah I = mr²).
Rigid body: τ = (Σmᵢrᵢ²)α = Iα, I = Σmᵢrᵢ²; I mass aur us ki axis se doori dono par munhasir.
Hoop I = mr², disc ½mr², sphere ⅖mr², patli rod (1/12)mL².
